AVIS A MANIFESTATION D’INTERÊTS N°057 /HISWACA /26

POUR LE RECRUTEMENT DE DIX- HUIT (18) ANALYSTES THEMATIQUES POUR APPUYER LES TRAVAUX D'ANALYSE DE L’ENQUETE DEMOGRAPHIQUE DE SANTE DU CONGO (EDSC-III)

 

1.Le Gouvernement de la République du Congo a reçu un financement additionnel de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement (IDA) pour la mise en œuvre des activités du « Projet d’Harmonisation et d’Amélioration des Statistiques en Afrique de l’Ouest et du Centre (HISWACA) », et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce financement pour effectuer les paiements au titre des contrats suivants : « recrutement de dix-huit (18) analystes thématiques pour appuyer les travaux d'analyse de l'EDSC-III».

2.Objectif principal

L’objectif principal est de recruter et mobiliser des analystes thématiques qualifiés pour produire un rapport d'analyse de l'EDSC-III de haute qualité, conforme aux standards internationaux des enquêtes EDS et répondant aux besoins d'information des décideurs.

3.Objectifs spécifiques

De façon spécifique, il s’agit de : (i) renforcer les capacités opérationnelles et méthodologiques de l'équipe d'analyse à travers un atelier de cadrage ; (ii) harmoniser la compréhension des canevas de rédaction et des outils d'analyse entre tous les analystes ; (iii) assurer la production de chapitres thématiques de qualité dans les délais impartis ; (iv) garantir la cohérence analytique et rédactionnelle de l'ensemble du rapport final.

4.Profil des analystes

Les profils requis par groupe thématique et le nombre d’analyste sont présentés dans le tableau suivant :

Nom du groupe

Chapitres traités

Profil des analystes

Nombre d’analyste

1. Méthodologie et contexte

Chapitre 1

Expert en échantillonnage et traitement DHS. Rôle de référent technique transversal, supervision qualité méthodologique.

1

2. Contexte socio-démographique

Chapitres 2–3

Démographes/statisticiens, forte maîtrise des analyses descriptives et indicateurs socio-économiques. Fournit le cadre d’interprétation du rapport.

2

3. Nuptialité et fécondité (niveau)

Chapitres 4–5

Démographe expérimenté en fécondité. Maîtrise des indicateurs EDS avancés et analyse des tendances.

2

4. Préférences et planification familiale

Chapitres 6–7

Spécialiste santé reproductive. Analyse de la demande, besoins non satisfaits, dynamique contraceptive. Forte orientation programme PF.

2

5. Mortalité

Chapitres 8 et 17

Expertise en estimation EDS de mortalité et analyse des biais. Nécessite encadrement technique étroit.

2

6. Santé maternelle et infantile

Chapitres 9–10

Spécialiste santé publique. Bonne connaissance des services de santé et du continuum de soins mèreenfant.

2

7. Nutrition et paludisme

Chapitres 11–12

Spécialistes sectoriels (nutrition, PNLP). Maîtrise des indicateurs techniques et capacité de liaison avec programmes nationaux.

2

8. VIH/Sida

Chapitres 13–14

Spécialiste VIH. Expérience en données biomarqueurs et analyse comportementale. Sensibilité dans l’interprétation.

2

9. Genre et autonomisation

Chapitre 15

Spécialiste genre/sciences sociales. Analyse des normes sociales, pouvoir de décision et dynamiques intraménage. Forte capacité analytique qualitative.

1

10. Conditions de vie et protection des enfants

Profil mixte (INS, UNICEF, ministères sociaux). Expertise WASH et protection de l’enfant.

2

Total

 

 

18

 5.Critères d'éligibilité

            Les candidats devront répondre aux critères suivants :

  • être titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire (Bac+4 minimum) en statistique, démographie, santé publique, épidémiologie ou domaine connexe ;
  • justifier d'une expérience d'au moins cinq (05) ans dans l'analyse de données d'enquêtes ou en recherche quantitative ;
  • avoir participé à au moins une enquête nationale de type EDS, MICS ou similaire ;
  • être spécialiste sectoriel de la thématique est un atout.

6.Composition du dossier

Le dossier de candidature doit comprendre :

  • une lettre de motivation adressée au Coordonnateur du projet HISWACA en précisant la thématique à analyser ;
  • un curriculum vitae détaillé et actualisé ;
  • les copies des diplômes et attestations de travail ;
  • la liste des publications ou rapports d'analyse réalisés (si disponible) ;
  • tout document attestant d'une expérience dans les enquêtes EDS ou similaires.

7.L’Unité de gestion du projet HISWACA invite les consultants individuels à manifester leur intérêt en vue de fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les consultants individuels intéressés doivent fournir les informations sur leur qualifications et expérience démontrant qu’ils sont qualifiés pour les prestations.

8.La sélection du consultant se fera en accord avec les procédures définies dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissements (FPI) de la Banque mondiale (version de juillet 2016, révisée en novembre 2017, août 2018, septembre 2023 et septembre 2025).

9.Les cnsultants peuvent obtenir les termes de références de la mission par courriel à l’adresse : recrutementhiswaca@gmail.com / ugp@hiswaca-congo.org, de 9 heures à 12 heures et de 14 heures à 16 heures (heures locales) du lundi au vendredi.

 

10.Les manifestations d’intérêts doivent être écrites en langue française et envoyées en utilisant le lien ou ou QR-CODE ci-dessous au plus tard le mardi 18 août 2026 (à minuit, heure locale) et porter clairement la mention du groupe thématique pour lequel le consultant fait acte de candidature.

 FOR SELECTION OF INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT

1. The Karachi Water & Sewerage Corporation (KW&SC) have received a loan through EAD, Government of Pakistan from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) / Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) and the counterpart share of funds from GOS for the Project Implementation Unit (PIU), Karachi Water & Sewerage Services Improvement Project (KWSSIP-II).

Data Scientist (Data Visualization Specialist) (01 Position)

 

  • Master’s degree (minimum) from an HEC-Recognized university in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5–10 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in large-scale data-analytics and machine-learning projects.
  • Experience working with utilities, public-sector organizations, infrastructure agencies or development institutions will be preferred.
  • Experience in projects funded by International Financing Institutions or donors (preferably the World Bank) will be an added advantage.

2

Project Manager (Electro-Mechanical) (01 Position)

 

  • Bachelor’s degree with a major in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering plus a Master’s degree in related fields or equivalent from the Higher Education Commission (HEC)-recognized university is required. The postgraduate certificate or diploma in project/construction management shall be preferable.
  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience on major civil and mechanical works projects; strong knowledge and experience with FIDIC contracts and MDB-funded projects is required.
  • The candidate should have strong technical and engineering skills and experience including planning, design, preparation of specifications and bidding packages, construction supervision and contract/project management.
  • The candidate should have good knowledge of World Bank safeguards policies and practices, procurement guidelines and regulations, monitoring and evaluation (M&E) and GIS.
  • Membership and/or registration with a recognized professional engineering body is a requirement.

3

Project Manager (Water & Sewerage) (01 Position)

 

  • Bachelor’s degree with a major in Civil Engineering plus a Master’s degree in Civil/Water & Wastewater Engineering/Sanitary Engineering/Hydraulic/Construction Management or equivalent from the Higher Education Commission (HEC)-recognized university is required. The postgraduate certificate or diploma in project/construction management shall be preferable.
  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience on major civil and mechanical works projects; strong knowledge and experience with FIDIC contracts and MDB-funded projects is required.
  • The candidate should have strong technical and engineering skills and experience including planning, design, preparation of specifications and bidding packages, construction supervision and contract/project management.
  • The candidate should have a good appreciation and knowledge of World Bank safeguards policies and practices, procurement guidelines and regulations, monitoring and evaluation (M&E) and GIS.
  • Membership and/or registration with a recognized professional engineering body is a requirement.

4

Procurement Assistant (01 Position)

 

  • Bachelor’s or higher degree from HEC recognized University in Engineering /   Business/Economics & Finance or Commerce.
  • Possesses management experience of 5 years working on procurements preferably under the World Bank or comparable projects.
  • The incumbent should have good knowledge of procurement of both international and local processes.

1. Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar a reçu un financement de Banque Mondiale pour financer le Projet de productivité et de résilience des moyens de subsistance ruraux (RIZ PLUS), et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce crédit pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat de consultant individuel objet du présent appel à candidatures.

Ce contrat sera financé conjointement par l’Agence Française de Développement (AFD). La passation du Marché sera conforme aux règles de passation des marchés de la Banque mondiale.

2. Sous l'autorité du Coordonnateur National, sous la coordination opérationnelle du Coordonnateur National Adjoint et sous l'orientation technique du Conseiller en Infrastructures Environnementales et Paysagères (CIEP), le/la consultant(e) sera chargé(e) d'assurer le pilotage technique, opérationnel et fiduciaire de la Composante 1 du Projet RIZ PLUS. Il/Elle veillera notamment à la planification, à la coordination et au suivi des activités de restauration des bassins versants et de promotion des pratiques agroécologiques, à la gestion des marchés relevant de la composante, au respect des exigences environnementales et sociales, ainsi qu'à la coordination avec les partenaires institutionnels et les unités régionales afin d'assurer l'atteinte des objectifs du Projet.

Le poste est basé à Antananarivo avec des déplacements fréquents dans les régions d'Alaotra Mangoro et de Sofia. Le contrat est prévu jusqu'au 29 décembre 2028, sous réserve d'évaluations satisfaisantes des performances du/de la consultant(e).

3. Les Termes de Référence détaillés peuvent être obtenus auprès de l'Unité de Gestion du Projet RIZ PLUS ou demandés à l'adresse électronique indiquée ci-dessous. Les candidats devront clairement préciser leurs coordonnées dans leur demande.

4. L’Unité de Gestion du Projet RIZ PLUS invite les candidat(e)s à manifester leur intérêt pour fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Un Consultant sera sélectionné conformément à la méthode de Sélection de Consultants Individuels prévue dans le « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d'Investissement (FPI) de la Banque mondiale », 7 édition – septembre 2025. Les candidats les mieux classés à l'issue de l'évaluation des dossiers seront invités à un entretien.

5. Le/la consultant(e) recherché(e) devra répondre aux qualifications minimales suivantes :

  •  Être titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 minimum (Master II, Ingénieur ou équivalent) en agronomie, foresterie, agroforesterie, gestion des ressources naturelles, sciences de l'environnement, aménagement du territoire ou toute autre discipline pertinente ;
  • Justifier d'au moins dix (10) années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans les domaines de la gestion des ressources naturelles, de la gestion des bassins versants, de l'agroforesterie, de l'agroécologie ou du développement rural 
  • Justifier d'au moins cinq (5) années d'expérience dans des projets financés par des bailleurs de fonds internationaux ;
  • Avoir piloté ou coordonné au moins deux (2) missions portant sur une composante « bassins versants », « approche paysage » ou « agroécologie » ;
  • Avoir participé à la préparation, à l'évaluation ou au suivi de marchés selon les procédures de la Banque mondiale sur au moins deux (2) projets ;
  • Disposer d'une bonne connaissance des techniques de restauration des bassins versants, de l'agroforesterie et des pratiques agroécologiques ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance des procédures de la Banque mondiale, notamment en matière de passation des marchés et du système STEP ;
  • Maîtriser le français et le malagasy ; la connaissance de l'anglais est souhaitée

Seront considérés comme des atouts :

  • Une expérience dans les régions d'Alaotra Mangoro et/ou Sofia ;
  • Une expérience dans la mise en œuvre de mécanismes de type Cash for Work, Cash/Land for Trees ou de sécurisation foncière communautaire ;
  • Des certifications en gestion de projet (PMP, Prince2 ou équivalent) ou en évaluation environnementale ;
  • La maîtrise d'outils (QGIS, ArcGIS ou équivalent) 

6. Les candidat(e)s intéressé(e)s sont invités à déposer leurs dossiers de candidature, par courrier électronique ou sous pli fermé, comprenant une lettre de motivation, un CV détaillé avec références professionnelles, les copies certifiées conformes des diplômes ainsi que les attestations de travail.

FEDERAL GOVERNMENT OF NIGERIA

FEDERAL MINISTRY OF WATER RESOURCES AND SANITATION

IN COLLABORATION WITH THE FEDERAL MINISTRY OF POWER

SUSTAINABLE POWER AND IRRIGATION FOR NIGERIA (SPIN) PROJECT

IDA Credit No: IDA-76370

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST FOR CONSULTANCY SERVICES

Assignment Title: ENGAGEMENT OF A CONSULTING FIRM FOR HYDROPOWER PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIPS (PPP) PROCESS AND GUIDELINES REVIEW

Reference No.: FMWR&S/SPIN/QCBS/CS/2026/013

The Federal Government of Nigeria (FGN), through the Federal Ministry of Water Resources and Sanitation (FMWRS) in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Power (FMP), has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of implementing the Sustainable Power and Irrigation for Nigeria (SPIN) Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds to finance the engagement of a Consulting Firm for the Hydropower Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) Process and Guidelines Review.

The SPIN Project is designed to strengthen dam safety and improve the management of water resources for hydropower and irrigation in selected areas of Nigeria. The FGN through the development of a Hydropower Master Plan (HMP) seeks to increase collaboration between the FMWR&S and the FMP to attract private investment and partnerships in the hydropower sector. This requires an assessment of the existing legal, regulatory, institutional, and procedural frameworks governing private sector participation in the development and operation of brownfield and greenfield hydropower projects, to support efficient, transparent, and bankable implementation of the HMP.

Purpose of the Assignment

The consulting services ("the Services") seek to engage a qualified and competent consulting firm ("the PPP Advisory Firm") to assess the applicability and effectiveness of Nigeria's existing PPP legal, regulatory, and institutional frameworks as they apply to hydropower project development, and to provide recommendations for their enhancement, subject to the approval of the Infrastructure Concession Regulatory Commission (ICRC). The assignment will further support institutional capacity building for relevant stakeholders to strengthen readiness for effective implementation of the Hydropower Master Plan.

The Federal Ministry of Water Resources and Sanitation in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Power, through the Federal Project Management Unit (FPMU) of the SPIN Project, now invites eligible consulting firms ("Consultants") to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested firms must provide sufficient information demonstrating that they meet the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The implementation period for this assignment shall be six (6) months from the date of contract signing.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following link: https://1drv.ms/w/c/bea66a6a0847ee73/IQC1Z4MJC3tSTb0VnyJxEgpCAdb5VnyGP02NAi_3vt0u0Io?e=TJuBf2

The shortlisting criteria are:

  • The firm shall have a minimum of ten (10) years of demonstrated experience providing Public-Private Partnership (PPP) advisory services, including transaction advisory, legal/regulatory framework review, and institutional strengthening, preferably within the infrastructure, power, or energy sectors.
  • The firm shall demonstrate experience assessing legal, regulatory, and institutional frameworks for private sector participation in infrastructure or hydropower/energy project development, including PPP policy, procurement, and contract management frameworks.
  • The firm shall demonstrate technical familiarity with the hydropower sector and/or Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM), and an understanding of the interface between water resources management and power generation.
  • The firm shall demonstrate prior experience designing and delivering institutional capacity building and knowledge transfer programmes (training, mentorship, coaching) for public sector agencies.
  • The firm shall demonstrate its technical and managerial capabilities in providing Public-Private Partnership (PPP) advisory services.

 

Evidence of similar assignments previously undertaken (Contract Award Letters, Job Completion Letters, and other evidence that may be required to verify such experience).

NOTE: Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

Selection of the Consulting Firm:

Consultants will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, 7th Edition (September 2025) ("Procurement Regulations"), and open to all eligible firms as defined therein.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank's Procurement Regulations, setting forth the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms in the form of a Consortium/Joint Venture to enhance their qualifications and should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all partners shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected. Evidence of such association must be provided in the Expression of Interest.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in written form to the address below (in person, by mail, or by e-mail) on or before 2:00 p.m. on 18th September 2026.

DUTY STATION:                    BoSS-HQ, Juba- South Sudan

Ref No:  SS-BOSS-562893-CS-QCBS

The Government of the Republic of South Sudan (GoSS), represented by the Central Bank of South Sudan also referred to as Bank of South Sudan (BoSS), is implementing the Strengthening South Sudan’s Financial Sector (3SF) Project, which is being financed with a grant from the International Development Association of the World Bank. The objective of the project is to strengthen the institutional and supervisory capacity of the central bank and improve the efficiency of core financial sector infrastructure. This objective will be achieved by strengthening and modernizing the central bank, which is critical for financial stability and key for transforming the banking sector and driving private-sector growth.

The Project is primarily aimed at supporting the institutional strengthening of the Central Bank. The project is premised on the notion that a strengthened central bank is key for transforming the banking sector and spurring private sector led growth. In addition to supporting capacity building within BoSS, the project will also support the development of a holistic approach towards addressing existing financial sector challenges.  The objective of the project is to strengthen the institutional and supervisory capacity of the central bank and improve the efficiency of core financial sector infrastructure. The project has four (4) components: ((i) formulating Financial Sector Policies; (ii) institutional strengthening of the central bank; (iii) development and modernization of key infrastructure; and (iv) project management and coordination.

3SF is seeking to use a portion of the grant to procure a qualified Regional Banking and Finance Institute to operationalize the SSIBF as a self-sustaining banking institute capable of independently designing, marketing, delivering, certifying, and commercializing banking and finance training services by the end of the 18-month assignment. The selected institute will need to ensure that the SSIBF develops into a sustainable, market-responsive, and internationally competitive centre for professional banking and finance education and certification.

The consulting services (“Services”) is required to to (a) assess the SSIBF staff and operations, (b) build the capacity of SSIBF staff to implement its mandate, (c) deliver professional courses and certifications jointly, and (d) handover sustainable operations as detailed in the terms of reference.

Duration: The assignment period is expected to take 18 months, starting from the date of signing the contract.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained upon request through: atembulmalang@gmail.com

The BoSS now invites eligible firms (“Consultant”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.  The short-listing criteria are as follows:

  1. Be a legally registered and recognized banking or financial services training institution.
  2. Have demonstrated experience in banking education, certification, and institutional development.
  3. Have at least 10 years’ experience in financial sector training and capacity building with evidence of sustainable revenue generating training operations.
  4. Demonstrate prior experience in setting up, incubating and accelerating a professional training institution.
  5. Demonstrate expertise in curriculum development and competency-based training.
  6. Have experience in faculty mentorship and institutional handholding support.
  7. Demonstrate experience in joint certification and professional training delivery.
  8. Have regional or international accreditation as an institute for banking and financial services professionals.
  9. Demonstrate experience implementing similar assignments within emerging institutions, developing economies and fragile and/ or post conflict environments.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, Paragraphs 3.13 to 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: Procurement in Investment Project Financing; Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services, Seventh Edition, September 2025, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest and unfair competitive advantage.

Consultants may associate with other consultants in the form of a joint venture or a sub consultancy to enhance their qualifications. The nature of association, whether it is a joint venture or a sub consultancy, should clearly be stated. In case of joint venture, the Consultant leading the joint venture should be mentioned.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Selection Based on Consultant's Qualifications (CQS) set out in the Consultant Guidelines. Interested Consultant may obtain further information at the address below during office hours from 10:00 to 16:00 hours South Sudan on all working days.

Expressions of interest (EOI) should be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by August 31, 2025 at 5.00 P.M (South Sudan Time) marked clearly as; “Expression of Interest for Regional Banking and Finance Institute to Support the Operationalization of the South Sudan Institute of Banking and Finance (SSIBF).” and submitted to the address below.

1. The Government of Mozambique (GoM) has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of the Climate Resilient Roads for the North (CRRN), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consultancy Services for Preparation of Feasibility Study, Conceptual Design and Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) for Civil Works under Design and Build Methodology for the Road R689 Angoche – Monapo (160 km) in Nampula Province hereafter designated the “Services”.

2. The consulting services (“the Services”) include but not limited to the following:

  • Prepare the feasibility study and carry out an economic viability study based on international standards.
  • Conduct a climate vulnerability risk assessment to identify and evaluate the effects of climate change along the above-mentioned road and recommend climate adaptation measures to increase its resilience, using Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, climate projections and work with local meteorological agencies to model future flood risks under different emission scenarios.
  • Carry out a road safety assessment for identification of existing high-risk sections along the roads.
  • Prepare conceptual designs, financial models/payment schedules for the works and a confidential price estimate for civil works contracts.
  • Prepare the ESIA for the road projects sites to ensure the project design incorporates the mitigation measures for the potential negative impacts and maximizes the positive impacts of the project in a manner consistent with all applicable requirements of the World Bank Group Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) and the relevant national laws.
  • Prepare the bidding documents for works.

  • Profile of the Firm/Core business demonstrating experience in roads and bridge economic surveys, analysis and design experience.
  • Experience in conducting at least one project of feasibility study/preliminary design/preparation of detailed engineering designs of the minimum two-lane road/highways in similar geographical conditions during the last five years.
  • Experience in conducting climate vulnerability risk assessment for infrastructure projects, particularly road infrastructure, including bridges.
  • Experience in conducting at least one Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIA) and Environmental and preparing Social Management Plans (ESMPs) using World Bank standards and description during the least five (5) years.
  • Experience in preparing design and build bidding documents using the World Bank guidelines:
  • Technical and managerial capability of the firm; and
  • Experience in handling externally aided projects such as the World Bank and AfDB will be an advantage.
  • Experience in fragility, conflict, and violence affected countries is an added advantage.

Note that firms must attach the certificate(s) of completion for each reference of completed project.

Key experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

6. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The Government of Georgia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Kakheti Connectivity Improvement Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia (RDMRDI) now invites eligible Individual Consultants (“Consultants”) to express their interest in providing the following services: Individual Consultant for Preparation of Resettlement Action Plan Compliance Report. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The CVs of the candidates should cover the requested information.

The objectives of the assignment are to:

  • Conduct an independent assessment of RAP implementation and verify compliance with ESS5, the approved RAP, applicable national legislation, and project-specific agreements.
  • Verify that compensation and assistance entitlements have been delivered in full and at replacement cost (as applicable) and prior to the commencement of works on affected assets/land.
  • Assess whether livelihood restoration and support measures (including for severely affected and vulnerable households) have been implemented and are effective.
  • Assess the functionality and performance of the Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM), including accessibility, timeliness, transparency, and satisfaction with resolutions.
  • Confirm that consultation, disclosure and engagement commitments have been met and that affected persons have been adequately informed (including regarding the GRM and undersigned agreements).
  • Prepare a RAP Compliance Report that concludes whether the RAP has been implemented satisfactorily and, if not, specifies gaps and a time-bound Corrective Action Plan (CAP) with responsibilities

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following link:

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/zs6rm5kpt88d3ru1qop6r/AM1zHwI_bSt-8_Gl8adhzlM?rlkey=uuu4z9mdvuef7kjk9kqsowv3v&st=4k2ta0mn&dl=0

The Qualification Requirements for selection of the Consultant are as follows:

  • Demonstrated at least 7 years of experience in World Bank ESF/ESS5 (or equivalent) resettlement planning, implementation monitoring and compliance verification.
  • Proven track record of conducting independent compliance audits/assessments for land acquisition and resettlement.
  • Experience with survey design, statistical sampling, and socio-economic outcome assessment.
  • Demonstrated capacity to undertake fieldwork in Georgia and produce reports in English and Georgian.

The period of the consultancy services shall be 8 weeks and the remuneration will be Lump sum.

Note: The Road Department reserves it’s right to verify submitted references and use obtained information for evaluation purposes.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”,  Seventh Edition,  September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.  In addition, please refer to the following specific information on conflict of interest related to this assignment: The consultant shall not receive any payment in connection with the assignment except as provided in the contract. AVIS D’APPEL A CANDIDATURE POUR LE RECRUTEMENT DE DEUX (02) STAGIAIRES EN COMPTABILITE A LA COORDINATION NATIONAL

Date de Publication : le 24 Juillet 2026

  1. INTRODUCTION

Depuis le début de l'année 2026, l'escalade du conflit entre les États-Unis et l'Iran a provoqué des chocs sans précédent sur les marchés mondiaux. Au-delà de l'instabilité géopolitique immédiate, cette crise a entraîné une rupture majeure des chaînes d'approvisionnement dans le détroit d'Ormuz, zone névralgique par laquelle transite une part significative du commerce mondial d'hydrocarbures. Cette situation a généré une inflation importée, touchant de plein fouet les produits de première nécessité. Comme pour les nations dépendantes des importations d'énergie et de denrées alimentaires, l’approvisionnement en produits pétroliers aux Comores connaît des perturbations créant des hausses brusques des prix de certains produits de manière disproportionnée par rapport aux revenus réels des populations. Les ménages déjà précaires se retrouvent dans une incapacité structurelle de couvrir leurs besoins caloriques et sanitaires de base.

Dans le cadre de la réponse aux impacts socio-économiques de cette crise, le Gouvernement de l’Union des Comores, avec l’appui de la Banque mondiale, met en œuvre un programme de transferts monétaires d’urgence adossé au Projet de Filets Sociaux de Sécurité Résilients et Réactifs aux Chocs (PFSS-RRC). Cette intervention vise à garantir la sécurité alimentaire, la stabilité socio-économique et le capital humain des ménages les plus vulnérables en atténuant les impacts directs et indirects de l'inflation et de la pénurie de ressources causées par le conflit.

Afin d’augmenter le nombre de spécialistes en comptabilités, le Gouvernement de l’Union des Comores à travers le PROJET DE FILETS SOCIAUX DE SECURITE RESILIENTS ET REACTIFS AUX CHOCS (PFSS-RRC) recrute deux (02) stagiaires en comptabilité diplômés dans les domaines de gestion, comptabilité, etc. 

  1. OBJECTIF DU PROGRAMME DE STAGE

L’objectif du programme de stage est de renforcer les capacités techniques et les comportements au travail du/de la stagiaire en lui facilitant des expériences pratiques sur le terrain et dans le milieu professionnel dans la comptabilité. A la fin du stage, les bénéficiaires auront une expérience professionnelle pratique dans le domaine de la comptabilité, liée au domaine de leur formation universitaire. Les stagiaires sont censés acquérir les connaissances et les compétences liés à la comptabilité et aux procédures de la Banque Mondiale. Un certificat d’attestation de stage, signé par le Coordinateur National sera octroyé aux stagiaires après les deux ans effectivement passés à acquérir les compétences requises pour devenir un Comptable. La durée du stage pourra être écourtée dans le cas du non-respect des règlements de travail en vigueur dans l’UGP. Une observation écrite sera faite au stagiaire pour les manquements avérés. Après deux observations, le stagiaire sera renvoyé sans attestation de stage.

  1. CONDITIONS DE CANDIDATURE POUR LE STAGE

Les conditions requises sont les suivantes :

  • Être titulaire d’un diplôme de grandes écoles au minimum de Bacc+3 en gestion ;
  • Avoir une connaissance de l’outil informatique
  • Avoir une maîtrise du français (écrit, oral)
  • Avoir moins de 30 ans
  • Avoir de bonnes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français. La maîtrise de l’anglais sera un avantage. 
  1. DOSSIER DE CANDIDATURE

Le dossier à soumettre doit comprendre les documents suivants :

  • Lettre de motivation adressé au Coordinateur national ;
  • Curriculum Vitae actualisé,
  • Copie du diplôme,
  • Copie des attestations,
  • Copie de la pièce d’identité.

Les Candidats intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires (TDR…) sur le site web : pfss-comores.org

Les critères d’éligibilité, l’établissement de la liste restreinte et la procédure de sélection seront conformes aux procédures spécifiées dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés de la Banque mondiale, 7ème Edition Septembre 2026. La méthode de sélection est la « Sélection de Consultants Individuels (SCI) ».

Les manifestations d’intérêts doivent être déposées physiquement à la Coordination Nationale ou aux Bureaux Régionaux de chaque Direction avec la mention suivante :

Recrutement des deux (02) Stagiaires en Comptabilité pour la Coordination Nationale ;

The ECOWAS strategic objective being implemented by the West African Power Pool (WAPP) is based on a dynamic vision of integrating national power grids into a unified regional electricity market, so that such a mechanism would, over the medium and long term, ensure to the ECOWAS citizens access to adequate power quality at an affordable price, and enhance the economic development of the Member States including industrialization growth, Health and Education improvement, Poverty Reduction, various Employment Opportunities Creation, etc…

To achieve its vision of operationalizing a unified ECOWAS regional electricity market, the WAPP Information and Coordination Centre (WAPP ICC), a Department within the WAPP Secretariat has been designated to perform the functions of a System Market Operator (SMO) responsible for coordinating the reliability of the WAPP Interconnected Transmission System (WAPPITS) made up of the power systems of fourteen (14) ECOWAS Member Countries and administration of the regional electricity market.

To this end, the WAPP Secretariat with the support of the World Bank within the Project “WAPP Côte d’Ivoire Interconnection and operationalization of the ECOWAS Regional Electricity Market” intends to reinforce staffing of the ICC Department by filling a key vacant position, that of a Power System Data Management & Data Analytics Engineer

The Engineer will be selected competitively, and the successful candidates will be joining the current team in the Information and Coordination Centre (ICC) as it prepares to operationalize the ECOWAS Regional Electricity Market.

2. ROLE OVERVIEW

Under the supervision of the Head of the System Operations Coordination Division, the Power System Data Management & Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for the management of the ICC's Power System Database. He/She extracts data from various sources (APIs, HIVE tables, and other structured and unstructured data sources) to process and store large volumes of data, ensuring their accuracy, consistency and security. He/She develops reporting dashboards and analytical tools to support the analysis of power system operations, and supports the design, testing and implementation of models and databases for all systems requiring the WAPP Network Model.

The detailed Job description for the assignment may be consulted and/or downloaded from the WAPP website at: www.ecowapp.org/en/tenders

The WAPP General Secretariat invites eligible Individual Consultants to express their interest in providing the required Services described in the Job decription. Interested Consultants must provide information demonstrating that they possess the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services by submitting: (a) a cover letter/motivation letter, and (b) an up-to-date detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV).

WAPP is an equal opportunity employer that offers equal chances to men and women. Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.  

3. LANGUAGE

Good oral and written communication skills in English and French  

4. DURATION OF MISSION

The successful candidate shall be offered an initial Consultancy Contract of approximatively 17 months from the beginning of the assignment ( i.e.until April 30, 2028). Upon completion of the World Bank funding, the position shall be absorbed by WAPP.

The beginning of the assignment is planned for November 2026

5. SELECTION METHOD

The Consultant will be selected in accordance with the method of "Selection of Individual Consultants" described in the World Bank "Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (edition September 2025).  

6. SUBMISSION OF APPLICATIONS

Applications must be submitted exclusively by email and should bear the subject line: “Application for ICC Engineer- Reference: BJ-WAPP-568960-CS-INDV”.

Paper applications will not be accepted.

Applications may be submitted in either French or English and should be sent to: procurement@ecowapp.org

 Particular emphasis should be placed on references for relevant similar assignments previously carried out, which should be clearly highlighted and described.

Deadline for submission of applications:  September 24, 2026, at noon, 12:00 pm, Benin local time (GMT+1).

spos@ecowapp.org

The firm shall work in close collaboration with the Grenada Fisheries Division, the Grenada UBEC Project Team, the OECS Programme Management Unit (PMU), and fisheries counterparts in St. Lucia and St. Vincent and the Grenadines.

 

You can find the detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment at the following websites: www.procurement.gd or https://in-tendhost.co.uk/GND/aspx/Home. Alternatively, you can email beverley.jeremiah@procurement.gov.gd  for assistance with the TOR or help with registering on In-tend.

 

The Ministry of Mobilisation, Implementation, and Transformation hereby invites eligible consultants to express their interest in providing the required services. Interested consultants are requested to submit information that demonstrates their qualifications and relevant experience to effectively carry out the services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers September 2023, revised November 2020, August 2018 and November 2017(“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best-qualified consultant to carry out the services will be selected in accordance with the Consultant Qualification Selection (CQS) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

The Consultant must have the following qualifications and experience:

  • Demonstrated institutional experience delivering fisheries management or marine governance assignments in the Caribbean region or comparable SIDS context. Minimum three completed assignments of comparable scope in the last ten years.

 

  • In-house capacity in: fisheries policy development; legislative gap analyses; FAD management; stakeholder engagement; and communications. Evidence of in-house capacity must be demonstrated through CVs of proposed key personnel.

 

  • Prior experience delivering assignments financed by the World Bank, IDB, CDB, GEF, or comparable multilateral institutions. Familiarity with World Bank Environmental and Social Standards (ESS) and procurement procedures.

 

  • Demonstrated track record of delivering structured on-the-job mentoring and capacity building programmes as an integrated component of technical assistance engagements in SIDS or developing country contexts.

 

Further information can be obtained by requesting clarification via Intend https://in-tendhost.co.uk/GND/aspx/Home .

Expressions of interest must be submitted electronically through the procurement system at https://in-tendhost.co.uk/GND/aspx/Home . Candidates must register on this portal and submit all interest and queries through this medium. Upon submission of documents, you will receive a confirmation email acknowledging receipt.

Deadline date of submission: September 18th, 2026, at 3:00 P.M.

Recrutement d’une ONG nationale pour l’accompagnement social des investissements et le renforcement des capacités communautaires dans la zone Est du projet RESITCHAD.

 

No de DON : IDA N° E207

 

N° de référence : TD-CHAD-RFSP-541713-CS-QCBS

 

Le Gouvernement de la République du Tchad a reçu un financement sous forme de don de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) pour la mise en œuvre du Projet de Développement Territorial et de Résilience au Tchad (RESITCHAD), et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce don pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat suivant : « Recrutement d’une ONG nationale pour l’accompagnement social des investissements et le renforcement des capacités communautaires dans la zone Est du projet RESITCHAD ».

 

Le consultant assurera notamment les prestations suivantes :

  • Accompagner socialement les bénéficiaires pour garantir l'appropriation des investissements,
  • Renforcer les capacités techniques et organisationnelles des acteurs communautaires et locaux,
  • Structurer et formaliser les mécanismes de gestion pour assurer la pérennisation des acquis,
  • Mettre en place un système de monitoring pour garantir la durabilité des impacts.

 

La durée de la mission sera de vingt-quatre (24) mois.

 

La Coordination du Projet RESITCHAD, invite les ONG nationales (« Consultants ») admissibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et une expérience pertinente pour l’exécution des Services. Les critères pour l’établissement de la liste restreinte sont (i) l’existence légale et expérience générale du Consultant (ii) l’expérience spécifique en mobilisation communautaire et développement local (iii) l’expérience dans les projets financés par les partenaires techniques et financiers (iv) la présence opérationnelle dans la zone d'intervention ou capacité démontrée à intervenir (v) l’expertise en genre, inclusion sociale, gestion des conflits et renforcement de capacités.

 

Pour être valables, les renseignements à fournir sur les références doivent être accompagnés de pièces justificatives des missions similaires exécutées par le candidat (copies des contrats (comprenant la page de garde et la page de signature), attestation de bonne fin d’exécution y relatif…).  La recevabilité des missions en cours est conditionnée à un taux d'exécution minimum de 80 % avec attestation.

 

Il est porté à l’attention des Consultants que les dispositions des paragraphes 3.14 ; 3.16 et 3.17 de la Section III du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant de la Banque Mondiale le Financement des Projets d’Investissement (Le Règlement) – 7é édition de Septembre 2025 », relatives aux règles de la Banque Mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts, sont applicables.

 

Les Consultants peuvent s’associer avec d’autres firmes pour renforcer leurs compétences respectives en la forme d’un groupement solidaire ou d’un accord de sous-traitant.

Traitement des groupements et de la sous-traitance :

  •  Ancienneté du cabinet : il sera retenu l'ancienneté du mandataire (chef de file) du groupement.
  • Références similaires : recevables au titre du mandataire ou des cotraitants, à condition que la part du membre concerné dans le marché de référence atteigne un seuil minimum de 30% du volume, et avec mention explicite du rôle exercé (chef de file ou cotraitant). Les références des sous-traitants ne sont pas recevables.
  • Couverture multisectorielle : les secteurs couverts par chaque membre du groupement sont cumulables ;
  • Capacité organisationnelle : La capacité organisationnelle est appréciée au titre du seul mandataire. 

 

Un Consultant sera sélectionné selon la méthode de Sélection Fondée sur la Qualité et le Coût (SFQC), telle que décrite dans le Règlement.

 

Les Consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires ou les termes de référence de la mission à l’adresse ci-dessous et aux heures suivantes : du Lundi au Jeudi de 07 heures à 15 heures 30 minutes et le Vendredi de 07 heures à 12 heures (heure locale).

 

Votre manifestation d’intérêt écrite doit être déposée à l’adresse ci-dessous en personne, par courrier, par facsimilé ou par courrier électronique au plus tard le xxxxxxxxxx à xxxxxxxx.

Título da Contratação: Contratação de serviços técnicos especializados de consultoria em engenharia para atuação como Engenheiro, conforme condições de contrato do Livro Amarelo (Yellow Book) da Federação Internacional de Engenheiros de Consultoria – FIDIC, Segunda Edição, 2017, e atuação como Gerente de Projeto conforme condições de contrato de Projeto e Obras Menores de 2025 do Banco Mundial do Programa Centro+4D

Método de Seleção: Seleção Baseada na Qualidade e Custo (SBQC)

Número de Referência: BR-SMPAE-PMPA-507893-CS-QCBS

 

A Prefeitura Municipal de Porto Alegre, por meio da SECRETARIA MUNICIPAL DE PLANEJAMENTO E GESTÃO (SMPG), recebeu um confinanciamento do Banco Mundial e da Agência Francesa de Desenvolvimento para a execução do Programa de Revitalização da Área Central de Porto Alegre – CENTRO+4D. Parte desses recursos será destinada à contratação de serviços de consultoria técnica especializada (serviços de engenharia) para atuação como o Engenheiro, conforme condições de contrato do Livro Amarelo (Yellow Book) da FIDIC, e atuação como Gerente de Projeto, conforme condições de contrato padrão de Projeto e Obras Menores do Banco Mundial de 2025, para os serviços e obras do Programa Centro+4D.

Os serviços de consultoria (“Os Serviços”) incluem o apoio à Prefeitura Municipal de Porto Alegre na gestão de todos os contratos de serviços e obras de engenharia do Programa Centro+4D, envolvendo: (i) analisar projetos; (ii) acompanhar e supervisionar, de forma presencial, os serviços realizados pelos Contratados, verificando sua conformidade aos projetos; (iii) auxiliar no controle tecnológico; (iv) assessorar o cumprimento dos aspectos técnicos e socioambientais exigidos pelos Bancos Financiadores; (v) dar instruções; (vi) fazer determinações e emitir ordens de variação vinculantes às partes. O Termo de Referência (TdR) detalhado e demais informações estão disponíveis no site da Diretoria de Licitações e Contratos da Prefeitura de Porto Alegre: <https://prefeitura.poa.br/smpg/diretoria-de-licitacoes-e-contratos/selecao-baseada-na-qualidade-e-custo-sbqc>.

A duração estimada desta consultoria estará vinculada ao prazo de execução de obras do Programa Centro+4D mais o Período para Notificação de Defeitos (PND) e o prazo para emissão do Certificado de Execução das obras, estimado em um total de 1671 (um mil, seiscentos e setenta e um) dias, equivalendo a aproximadamente 55 (cinquenta e cinco) meses. 

A SMPG convida empresas de consultoria elegíveis (“Consultores”) a manifestarem seu interesse em fornecer os serviços acima. As empresas de consultoria interessadas deverão fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e a experiência relevante para executar Os Serviços. Os critérios de seleção são: experiência comprovada na gestão de contratos de serviços e obras de engenharia na modalidade do Livro Amarelo (Yellow Book) da FIDIC; estrutura gerencial compatível com a execução dos Serviços; tempo mínimo de atuação no mercado de 7 (sete) anos; portfólio técnico compatível com a natureza dos serviços.

Para Formação da Lista Curta serão avaliados os seguintes aspectos quanto à experiência da Proponente:

  1. Principal área de atuação, tempo de atividade nessa área, experiência relevante, capacidade técnica e estrutura gerencial da empresa;
  2. Contratos e clientes anteriores, informando detalhes de escopo, valor, duração, função no contrato, contato do gestor técnico de cada contrato pelo lado do contratante (nome, função, e-mail e telefone);
  3. Portfólio da empresa com destaque para a experiência em contratos de natureza e complexidade semelhantes.

Os Consultores serão selecionados de acordo com o método de Seleção Baseada na Qualidade e Custo (SBQC), estabelecido no Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento do Banco Mundial de fevereiro de 2025.

Os Consultores poderão associar-se a outras empresas para melhorar as suas qualificações, mas devem indicar claramente se a associação assume a forma de uma joint venture e/ou de uma subconsultoria. No caso de uma joint venture, todos os parceiros serão solidariamente responsáveis pela totalidade do contrato, se selecionados.

Chama-se a atenção dos Consultores para a Seção III, parágrafos 3.13, 3.15 e 3.16 do “Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento” (Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers) do Banco Mundial de fevereiro de 2025, estabelecendo a política do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesses.

As Manifestações de Interesse, currículos e portfólios deverão ser entregues até as 10 horas do dia 31 de agosto de 2026, na sede da Diretoria de Licitações e Contratos da Secretaria Municipal de Planejamento e Gestão, aos cuidados da Comissão Especial de Licitações, no Edifício Montaury, 5º Andar, situado à Rua Siqueira Campos, nº 1300, Centro Histórico, Porto Alegre/RS, CEP 90010-001, ou enviada por correio eletrônico ao endereço de e-mail celfin@portoalegre.rs.gov.br, especificando no campo assunto: 507893-CS-QCBS_Nome da Empresa.

Na hipótese de não haver confirmação de recebimento dos correios eletrônicos pela Comissão Especial de Licitações no prazo de 48 (quarenta e oito) horas, os documentos deverão ser reenviados, mantendo-se no histórico da mensagem o e-mail originalmente encaminhado.

Assignment Title: CONSULTING SERVICES FOR TRAINING AND CERTIFICATION FOR INSOLVENCY JUDGES AND ADMINISTRATORS  

Reference No. 82CS1/MINPLAN/26

The Government of Angola has received financing from the World Bank Group's International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Accelerating Economic Diversification and Job Creation Project (Diversifica Mais) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services for training and certification for insolvency judges and administrators.

The consulting services (“the Services”) consist of:

  1. Design, development and delivery of specialized training programs for judges and insolvency administrators on business recovery and insolvency, in accordance with the Angolan legal framework;
  2. Organization and certification of training courses for judicial and related professionals involved in corporate recovery and insolvency proceedings;
  3. Preparation of training content and materials, covering, among others, the following areas: (i) Legal framework for business recovery and insolvency; (ii) Commercial law; (iii) Labour law; (iv) Civil procedure law; (v) Accounting and taxation; (vi) Economics and business management; (vii) Insolvency, economic development and the business environment;
  4. Implementation, monitoring and evaluation of the training activities, including assessment of participants and issuance of certificates upon successful completion;
  5. Preparation and submission of the required deliverables, including the training plan, teaching materials, training reports and certification documentation.

The assignment includes legal, institutional, procedural, accounting, tax, economic, business management and capacity-building work, structured around the preparation, implementation, evaluation and certification of training activities for judges and insolvency administrators.

The expected duration of the services cannot exceed 12 months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Accelerating Economic Diversification and Job Creation Project (Diversifica Mais) now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. To be legally constituted and authorized to operate in the areas of consulting, training, capacity building or professional certification.
  2. Demonstrate at least 5 years of consolidated experience in providing consulting services, curriculum design, and implementation of training programs.
  3. To have successfully completed at least 3 similar projects in the last 5 years, preferably focused on the justice sector, insolvency, business recovery, judicial administration or economic governance.
  4. To be legally authorized to validate and issue qualification/attendance certificates to trainees.
  5. Demonstrate practical experience in engaging with and listening to stakeholders (e.g., courts, judges, government entities, professional associations).

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” revised in September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant Qualification Selection (CQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 0800 to 1600 hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (only by mail) until September 16, 2026.

O Estado de Alagoas recebeu financiamento do Banco Mundial para custear parcialmente o Programa Progestão Alagoas, e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos para serviços de consultoria.

Os serviços de consultoria (“Serviços”) referem-se à contratação de empresa de consultoria especializada para a realização de diagnóstico arquivístico, dimensionamento da massa documental, elaboração de estratégia tecnológica e apoio técnico à futura contratação dos serviços de digitalização dos registros funcionais dos servidores e ex-servidores do Poder Executivo do Estado de Alagoas.

É parte integrante desta Manifestação de Interesse o e Termo de Referência (TdR) no qual consta a descrição detalhada das atividades a serem desempenhadas e dos produtos a serem elaborados, e que está disponível no website: www.sefaz.al.gov.br/licitacao

O Estado de Alagoas convida empresas de consultoria elegíveis a manifestarem seu interesse na prestação dos Serviços. Empresas interessadas devem fornecer informações que comprovem possuir as qualificações e experiência necessárias para executar os Serviços. Os critérios de pré-seleção são:

  • Possuir experiência na área de gestão documental, considerando aspectos inerentemente arquivísticos, documentais, operacionais, tecnoloógicos, institucionais e normativos;

  • Possuir experiência na definição de critérios técnicos de priorização para futura digitalização/virtualização da massa documental;

  • Possuir experiência no apoio técnico para estruturação de ação para futura digitalização/virtualização dos registros funcionais;

  • Possuir experiência na capacitação de equipes técnicas para acompanhar futura contratação de serviço de digitalização/virtualização dos registros.

 

Por fim, é necessário que possua capacidade gerencial compatível com projetos de alta complexidade, com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas, assegurando a entrega de todos os produtos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e com o padrão de qualidade exigido pela Administração Pública. As empresas podem se associar para reforçar suas qualificações, devendo indicar claramente se a associação ocorre na forma de consórcio ou subcontratação. No caso de consórcio, todos os parceiros devem ser solidariamente responsáveis por todo o contrato, se selecionados.

A Consultoria será selecionada de acordo com o método Seleção Baseada em Qualidade e Custo – SBQC estabelecido pelo Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial, 4ª edição de novembro de 2020.

Government of Nepal

Kathmandu Valley Water Supply Management Board (KVWSMB)

Kathmandu Valley Water Security Improvement Project (KV WaSIP) –

Sisneri Water Supply Project

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

(CONSULTING SERVICES – INDIVIDUAL)

First Date of Publication: 27th August 2026

Senior Hydrologist - Ref No. KVWaSIP-IC-02-083/84

1.0 Background

The Government of Nepal (GoN) has received financing from the World Bank toward the preparation and implementation of the Kathmandu Valley Water Security Improvement Project (KV WaSIP) – Sisneri Water Supply Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. The consulting services include providing technical, procurement, financial management, environmental and social, contract management, and other professional support required for effective implementation of the Project through the Project Management Unit (PMU)

The Kathmandu Valley Water Supply Management Board (KVWSMB) now invites eligible Individual Consultants to indicate their interest in providing the above consulting services. Interested Consultants shall provide a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) demonstrating that they possess the required educational qualifications, professional experience, and technical competence to perform the services. The shortlisting criteria for each assignment are specified in the respective Terms of Reference (TOR), which may be obtained from the address or website indicated below

The Kathmandu Valley Water Supply Management Board (KVWSMB) intends to apply part of the proceeds of this financing to eligible payments under the contract for hiring Senior Hydrologist and requests applications from suitably qualified and interested candidates to fill the position.

2. The Objectives of the Assignment

As a team member of the Project Management Unit (PMU), the overall objective of the assignment is to provide specialist hydrological, hydraulic, sedimentation, and climate resilience support to the PMU for the feasibility confirmation, detailed design, and implementation readiness of the Sisneri Dam and associated bulk water supply system. The Senior Hydrologist will help ensure that the Project’s hydrological basis, reservoir yield assumptions, flood safety provisions, sediment management approach, and climate risk considerations are technically sound, robust, and consistent with international good industry practice and applicable World Bank requirements.

3. Duties and Responsibilities

The duties of the Specialist is mentioned in the Terms of Reference in detail.

4. Qualifications and Experience

All applications will be evaluated against the assignment’s required qualifications below.  

Candidates who comply with the qualifications will be scored according to predefined criteria. A minimum of three candidates will be shortlisted and interviewed. The candidate with the highest score will be invited to negotiate a contract. Referees of the selected candidate may be contacted to verify prior experience, performance, and interpersonal skills. 

 The Senior Hydrologist shall possess strong academic qualifications and demonstrated professional experience relevant to dam hydrology, sediment management, hydraulic analysis, and reservoir operations for large water infrastructure projects. The expert should have proven capability to review and guide hydrological investigations, assess design assumptions and modelling outputs, and provide technical advice on dam safety, flood management, sedimentation, and climate-related risks in the context of feasibility updating and detailed engineering design

Qualifications and Relevant Experience

  • Education:
    • The expert shall hold at least a bachelor’s degree in water resources engineering, hydrology, civil engineering, or a related discipline.
    • A master’s degree in hydrology, water resources, hydraulic engineering, or a closely related field is required, and a PhD will be considered an added advantage.
  • Work Experience:
  • At least 15 years of relevant professional experience in hydrological assessment, hydrological modelling, flood estimation, sediment studies, reservoir operation analysis, and review or design support for dam or major water resources infrastructure projects.
  • The expert shall demonstrate strong experience in hydrological data collection, interpretation, and modelling, including rainfall and streamflow analysis, rating curves, long-term flow generation, design flood estimation, probable maximum flood assessment, and flood routing for dams and associated hydraulic structures.
  • The expert shall have proven expertise in sediment assessment, reservoir sedimentation and management, reservoir operation studies, water availability and dry-season yield analysis, minimum release requirements, and evaluation of climate variability and climate change impacts on hydrological performance.
  • The expert shall have sound knowledge of hydrology-related dam safety, including dam-break analysis, emergency preparedness planning, downstream flood routing, inundation mapping, and risk mitigation, and experience coordinating with multidisciplinary dam or water supply teams; prior review, advisory, quality assurance, or panel-type roles will be an advantage.
  • Interpersonal Skills
    • The expert shall have strong analytical, report writing, and communication skills, and shall be able to communicate clearly and effectively in spoken and written English.

5. Evaluation and Selection Method

The Senior Dam Specialist will be hired by the PMU using the Open Competitive Selection of Individual Consultants method following “World Bank Procurement Regulations for Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services” (July 2016) Seventh Edition 2025. 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations”.

6. Duration of the Assignment

The Senior Hydrologist will perform the scope of these TORs for a duration of 15 months from contract signature on a full-time basis.

7. Remuneration

A market-based salary package commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications will be offered.

8. Reporting

The Senior Hydrologist will report directly to the Project Director, PMU

9. Location

  • The consultant will be based at the PMU office and may be required to travel outside the valley as needed for project-related procurement activities.
  • The Project shall provide following facilities to consultant during his tenure of service:
  • Office space
  • Email and internet access
  • Required office stationery and other materials
  • Photocopying/printing facilities

10. Application Process

Interested candidates shall submit a complete application package comprising:

  1. Up-to-date curriculum vitae (CV).
  2. Copies of academic and professional certificates.
  3. Contact details for at least three (03) professional references familiar with the candidate’s relevant work.

Applications shall be submitted electronically no later than 17.00 PM on 18th September 2026 to the following e-mail address: sisnerikvwsmb@gmail.com. Only complete applications received by the deadline will be considered.

1. Sous l'autorité directe du Responsable EAGER au niveau Régional, le/la titulaire du poste est chargé de la mise en œuvre opérationnelle et de la qualité des activités visant à renforcer l’accès à un emploi productif et à promouvoir l’entrepreneuriat durable chez les jeunes femmes bénéficiaires du programme.

Le/la titulaire contribue directement à l’atteinte des résultats du projet en matière de création d’opportunités économiques durables pour les jeunes femmes bénéficiaires.

 

3. Afin de réaliser les activités prévues dans le cadre du projet, le Fonds d’Intervention pour le Développement invite les personnes éligibles à manifester leur intérêt. Les candidats devront fournir toutes les informations pertinentes attestant de leurs qualifications et de leur expérience professionnelle, démontrant ainsi leur aptitude à exécuter les prestations prévues ci-dessous :

 

Qualifications :

 

  • Diplôme de Maîtrise (Bac +4) en économie, gestion de projet, entrepreneuriat, gestion, commerce, management, administration des affaires (notamment gestion d’entreprise, développement des affaires, management stratégique ou disciplines équivalentes).
  • Justifier d’au moins cinq (5) années d’expérience professionnelle cumulée dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants :

    • Formation professionnelle ;
    • Appui à l’entrepreneuriat ;
    • Projets d’autonomisation économique des femmes.

  • Une connaissance des chaînes de valeur régionales et des opportunités économiques locales constituerait un atout.

Compétences et aptitudes professionnels :

  • Compétence en analyse et suivi de données économiques ou sociales, attestée par des rapports ou outils produits.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication et de réseautage avec les acteurs du secteur privé, appuyées par des expériences de collaboration avec des entreprises, ONG ou acteurs économiques.
  • Maîtrise des outils de collecte de données et bureautique (Excel, Word).
  • Capacité d’adaptation à des contextes variés et parfois sensibles.
  • Sens de l’éthique, de l’écoute active et respect de la confidentialité confirmés par références professionnelles.

Le recrutement comportera deux (02) phases :

CONSULTANT’S QUALIFICATIONS BASED SELECTION (CQS)

Name of Project

Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI)

Loan No./Credit No./Grant No.

IBRD Loan No. 97800-BA

Assignment Title

Construction Supervision Services for Rehabilitation of Main Road MI-108 (M-4), Rebrovac - Kotor Varoš

Procurement Plan Ref. Number

BA-RS-SISRI-CS-CQS-26-1.2.4

Country of Delivery

Bosnia and Herzegovina (Republika Srpska)

The Ministry of Finance and Treasury of Bosnia and Herzegovina (the “Borrower”) has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the following consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) comprise construction supervision, project management and contract administration for the rehabilitation of the main road MI-108 (M-4), Rebrovac - Kotor Varoš (Works RFB No. BA-RS-SISRI-W-RFB-26-1.2.2), covering approximately 30.9 km. The Works include rehabilitation and reconstruction of pavement layers; earthworks; draninage and culverts; curbs and roadside works; traffic signage and road markings; road safety equipment; repair and rehabilitation of related structures and ancillary works; temporary traffic management; and environmental, social, occupational health and safety measures.

The Intended Completion Date for the Works is 540 days after the Commencement Date. The Services are expected to commence in coordination with the commencement of the Works and to cover the construction period and the related completion, close-out and Defects Liability Period services as specified in the Terms of Reference. The Defects Liability Period under the Works contract is 730 calendar days. The detailed scope, deliverables, level of effort and implementation arrangements are set out in the Terms of Reference.

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the primary procurement stage for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Public Company “Republic of Srpska Roads” Ltd. now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: “Procurement Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting, and Consulting Services, Seventh edition, September 2025” (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best qualified firm to carry out the Services will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

 Qualification requirements to be met by the Consultant:

1. Core business and general experience: at least seven (5) years of demonstrated experience in construction supervision, project management and/or contract administration of road or transport infrastructure works.

2. Relevant specific experience: successful completion, within the last ten (10) years, of at least two (2) assignments for supervision and contract administration of construction, reconstruction or rehabilitation of paved public roads of similar nature and complexity; at least one such assignment should have involved a road section or combined road sections of not less than approximately 20 km.

3. Similar technical scope: demonstrated firm-level experience supervising asphalt pavement rehabilitation/reconstruction, earthworks, drainage and culverts, curbs and roadside works, traffic signage and road markings, road safety equipment, related structures, temporary traffic management under live traffic conditions, and environmental and social requirements.

4. Technical and managerial capability: demonstrated organizational and management capacity for quality assurance/quality control, supervision of materials testing, measurement and certification of works, progress and cost control, contract administration, environmental and social compliance, occupational health and safety monitoring, and regular reporting.

5. Previous experience with World Bank or other international financial institution (IFI/MDB)-financed road infrastructure projects and related contract administration procedures will be considered an asset.

6. Experience in Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Western Balkans or comparable legal, climatic and operating environments will be considered and asset.

Interested Consultants should submit a concise company profile and evidence of relevant assignments, including the client, country, scope, duration, implementation period, value of the supervised works where available, the Consultant’s role, and client contact details for verification. In the case of an association, the Expression of Interest should clearly state the form and proposed role of each member/partner.

The qualifications and experience of individual Key Experts shall not be evaluated at the REOI stage and CVs of Key Experts are not required with the Expression of Interest.

Evaluation criteria

Consultants meeting the minimum qualification requirements set out above will be evaluated and ranked on the basis of their demonstrated qualifications and relevant experience related to the assignment. The evaluation will be based on the information submitted in the Expressions of Interest and in accordance with the following criteria:

  1. Core business, general experience and organizational capacity of the firm (20%)
  2. Relevant experience in supervision and contract administration of road projects of similar nature, scope and complexity (60%)
  3. Technical and managerial capability demonstrated through previous assignments (20%)

Further information can be obtained at the address below during regular business hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, by mail, or by e-mail) by 15 September 2026 at 10.00 am.

Public Company “Republic of Srpska Roads” Ltd. – Project Implementation Team

Tel: +387 51 334 500

Fax: +387 51 334 545

Dans le cadre du programme prioritaire du Gouvernement du Burundi visant le développement du capital humain et l’amélioration des résultats en matière d’emploi des jeunes, la République du Burundi, avec l’appui de la Banque Mondiale, met en œuvre le Projet d’Appui à l’Amélioration des Compétences pour l’Employabilité des Femmes et des Jeunes (PACEJ).

 Pays : République du Burundi

Date de publication : 04/09/2026

1. Contexte

Le Gouvernement de la République du Burundi, ayant obtenu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour la mise en œuvre du Projet de Développement du Capital Humain (PDCH), entend en affecter une partie au marché référencé, dans le cadre de sa stratégie visant à investir dans le capital humain et à renforcer les secteurs prioritaires de l’Éducation et de la Santé pour assurer la stabilité nationale et soutenir un développement durable.

À travers le Plan National de Développement 20182027 et la Vision 20402060, le pays s’engage à :

  • Assurer l’accès universel aux services de santé.
  • Garantir une éducation inclusive et de qualité.
  • Développer les compétences pour diversifier les emplois formels et promouvoir l’entrepreneuriat.

Avec 41,5 % de la population âgée de 0 à 15 ans en 2022, la jeunesse constitue la principale richesse nationale et la clé de la stabilité à long terme.

Le Burundi accueille également une importante population de réfugiés (86 300 en mars 2024, dont 39 % âgés de 5 à 17 ans). Une stratégie actualisée en 2023 prévoit :

  • Intégration des réfugiés et rapatriés dans les systèmes nationaux.
  • Harmonisation des systèmes d’éducation et de santé dans les zones de développement intégré.
  • Élaboration d’une stratégie éducative spécifique pour l’inclusion des réfugiés et l’accès des rapatriés au système scolaire burundais.

Deux projets éducatifs sont actuellement en cours d’exécution, sous la tutelle du MENRS et gérés par une UGP unique :

  • PACEJ : Projet d’Appui à l’Amélioration des Compétences pour l’Employabilité des Femmes et des Jeunes.
  • PDCH : Projet de Développement du Capital Humain

2. Description du marché

Le marché est structuré en deux (02) lots :

  • Lot 1 : Kits scolaires pour les enfants vulnérables du préscolaire.
  • Lot 2 : Kits scolaires pour les enfants vulnérables du fondamental et du post-fondamental.

Les soumissionnaires peuvent participer à un ou deux lots et se voir attribuer les deux s’ils remplissent les conditions cumulatives. Chaque offre doit couvrir l’ensemble des articles requis pour le lot concerné. Aucune variante n’est acceptée.

3. Procédure de passation

La passation du marché sera conduite par Appel d’Offres National (AON), conformément au Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant un Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) de la Banque mondiale, édition de septembre 2023.

4. Obtention du dossier d’appel d’offres

Les soumissionnaires intéressés peuvent obtenir un dossier complet en langue française contre un paiement non remboursable de 150 000 BIF, à effectuer comme suit :

  • 50 % au compte n° CC 14340 ouvert à la Banque de la République du Burundi (BRB) au nom du PJT DVPT CAP HUMAIN.
  • 50 % au compte n° 03104582392 (sous-compte de transit des recettes non fiscales) ouvert à la BRB au nom de l’Office Burundais des Recettes (OBR).

Les soumissionnaires éligibles et intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations auprès du Projet de développement du capital humain « PDCH », à l’attention de Monsieur le Coordonnateur du Projet, par e-mail : pacej@pacej.bi  avec copie à nirsanctus@gmail.com et muhindo.kiana@pacej.bi et hatungimanapatrick@gmail.com et prendre connaissance des documents d’Appel d’Offres à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous : Rohero I, Boulevard du Japon n°40, 1er étage, durant les heures de bureau, tous les jours ouvrables, du lundi au vendredi de 8h00 à 12h00 et de 14h00 à 17h30.

Le dossier sera remis directement par l’UGP du PDCH, à l’adresse indiquée ci-dessous.

Les offres devront être déposées au plus tard le 07/10/2026 à 10h00 (heure locale).

  • La soumission par voie électronique n’est pas autorisée.
  • Les offres remises en retard ne seront pas acceptées.
  • L’ouverture publique des offres aura lieu le 07/10/2026 à 10h15 (heure locale), en présence des représentants des soumissionnaires et de toute personne souhaitant y assister.

6. Garantie de soumission

Les offres doivent être accompagnées d’une déclaration de garantie de soumission, valide pendant 28 jours après la date limite de validité des offres.

7. Transparence et divulgation

Conformément au règlement de la Banque mondiale, l’emprunteur divulguera les informations sur la propriété effective du soumissionnaire retenu, via le formulaire inclus dans le dossier d’appel d’offres.
